verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a public REST API secured by API keys/Bearer tokens (activepieces-docs-2, activepieces-docs-28) and a built-in MCP server that lets AI assistants build flows via natural language (activepieces-docs-4, activepieces-docs-27), showing programmatic/agent-driven flow creation is supported. However, there is no concrete documentation of specific endpoints for updating or activating (publishing) a flow via the public API, and probes found no discoverable OpenAPI spec confirming the full CRUD surface, only general endpoint-overview docs and publishing-flow governance pages (activepieces-docs-22, activepieces-docs-23) that don't reference API usage explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoint reference for create/update/activate flow operations, and independent verification (e.g. a working example) that an agent can drive the full lifecycle purely through the REST API rather than the UI or MCP layer.
